g.text: J1 is the only part that is bought and placed.

g.desc: J1 is the only part that is bought and placed.

g.text: X3 and X4 are the maker's two Qwiic sockets (JST SH 4-pin, SM04B-SRSS-TB): pads only, NOT FITTED, not in the BOM.

g.desc: X3 and X4 are the maker's two Qwiic sockets (JST SH 4-pin, SM04B-SRSS-TB): pads only, NOT FITTED, not in the BOM.

g.text: A passive adaptor: the badge's 3.3 V, ground and I2C lines go straight to a Nunchuck plug. No chip, no LED, no resistor.

g.desc: A passive adaptor: the badge's 3.3 V, ground and I2C lines go straight to a Nunchuck plug. No chip, no LED, no resistor.

g.text: X2 is board copper: five gold fingers on the board edge (three on the back, two on the front) that the Nunchuck plug grips.

g.desc: X2 is board copper: five gold fingers on the board edge (three on the back, two on the front) that the Nunchuck plug grips.

g.text: Solder one on by hand to chain other 3.3 V I2C boards. SAO GPIO1 and GPIO2 are not used.

g.desc: Solder one on by hand to chain other 3.3 V I2C boards. SAO GPIO1 and GPIO2 are not used.

g.text: No I2C pull-ups on the board (docs/standard.md section 1; the maker fitted none either). A Nunchuck answers at I2C address 0x52.

g.desc: No I2C pull-ups on the board (docs/standard.md section 1; the maker fitted none either). A Nunchuck answers at I2C address 0x52.

g.text: BADGE POWER ONLY. No coin cell and no SAO / OFF / BAT switch (a recorded exception to docs/standard.md section 3): there is nothing

g.desc: BADGE POWER ONLY. No coin cell and no SAO / OFF / BAT switch (a recorded exception to docs/standard.md section 3): there is nothing

g.text: to light, and a Nunchuck is only useful while the badge is talking to it. With no cell on the board nothing can back-feed one.

g.desc: to light, and a Nunchuck is only useful while the badge is talking to it. With no cell on the board nothing can back-feed one.
